Subject: Promo/signup grant showing as billed tokens + VAT on allowance

Hi Sofia,

We signed up last week and our account was supposed to have a signup grant (self-serve). I just pulled our invoice for 2026-09-01 (attached) and it looks like token usage from the grant was billed instead of being consumed from the allowance — there's also a VAT line applied to the charged token amount.

Can you confirm:
- Whether the signup grant was applied to our account and why usage appears as billed tokens on the invoice?
- Why VAT was charged against what we thought was promotional credit?

We rely on the grant for initial experimentation; if the grant was consumed incorrectly, could you either reverse the charge or extend the grant while you investigate?

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: INV-20260901-CLD4821 — quick triage

Internal note / analysis: attaching a short usage extract (snippet).

Summary findings:
- Signup grant was created and applied on 2026-08-25 for 15,000 tokens. Grant record exists on account CLD-4821.
- Grant expired automatically on 2026-08-31 23:59 UTC due to a misconfigured TTL (we expected 14 days from first use; system TTL was set to local timezone expiry). Cloudful's heavy usage on 2026-08-31 (approx 09:00–14:00 UTC) crossed the expiry boundary.
- Because the grant expired mid-day, the subsequent calls were billed from paid balance and showed up as token charges on INV-20260901.
- VAT was charged because invoice was generated by our EU billing flow; promotional grants are not VAT-exempt in our current policy when they result in billed transactions on the invoice. Finance confirmed VAT applied to the billed amount, not to a non-invoiced credit.

Recommended immediate actions:
1) Issue a discretionary credit to negate the billed tokens consumed after the grant expiry window: 6,340 tokens (approx).
2) Reissue a replacement signup grant covering the gap and extend it by 14 days to make up for the premature expiry (15,000 tokens replacement).
3) Trigger invoice correction to re-run VAT calculation after credit is applied (finance must confirm process; likely results in a corrected invoice PDF and a credit memo).
4) Notify the customer and provide a provisional timeline (24–48 hours).

Attachments: usage_report_2026-08-31.csv (snippet)

Neha — can you confirm approval for the discretionary credit and whether we need a written request from Cloudful (accounts-payable) to process invoice correction? I think we can proceed under standard billing goodwill for signup grants but want your sign-off.

—Ben
Billing Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo/signup grant showing as billed tokens + VAT on allowance — resolution plan

Hi Liam — quick update and next steps. Thanks for your patience.

What happened (short):
- Our logs show your signup grant was created and applied, but it expired on 2026-08-31 at 23:59 UTC due to a TTL misconfiguration. Cloudful had elevated usage that spilled across the expiry window and the overage was billed on the 2026-09-01 invoice.
- VAT was charged on the billed amount in the generated invoice. The VAT line applies to what was invoiced, not to a promotional credit that never hit an invoice.

What we did:
- We issued a discretionary credit covering the billed token overage (6,340 tokens) and applied a replacement signup grant of 15,000 tokens to your account.
- We opened an invoice correction to re-run VAT calculations and generate a corrected invoice and credit memo. Updated invoice link: https://app.redwood.io/invoices/INV-20260901-CLD4821 (will show corrected PDF once processing completes).
- We also applied a 14-day extension to the new grant to ensure you have time to use the allowance.

Timeline: credit/grant applied immediately; invoice correction should appear within 24–48 hours. If your finance team needs a formal written request, please reply to this thread with a short confirmation and accounts-payable contact and we'll expedite.

Apologies for the confusion — we've also logged a bug for TTL handling on signup grants and will push a fix to prevent re-occurrence.

Please confirm you received the credit and whether you'd like us to cancel the corrected invoice notification to your AP team until the credit memo is finalized.

Best regards,
Sofia Ivanova
